scenarios.title: verified archived tasks on nosecretformula.vercel.app
scenarios.source_description: User can archive all completed tasks in one click via an "Archive completed" button at the bottom of the task list
steps: Navigate to https://nosecretformula.vercel.app/
Verify the acceptance criterion
scenarios.expected_result:
The run navigated from the Tasks page to the Archive page to check that two tasks (“Bulk archive A” and “Bulk archive B”) were no longer in the active task list and instead appeared in the Archive.
The Archive page loaded successfully and shows a table of archived tasks with a “Restore” button for each row.
What went wrong: the final confirmation step failed when checking that both tasks had been removed from the active list (i.e., verifying the move from Tasks to Archive). The run stopped on the Archive page during this verification.
Based on the Archive page screenshot, “Bulk archive A” and “Bulk archive B” are visible in the Archive list, but the automation could not confirm the other half of the requirement (that they are gone from the active Tasks list). This likely failed because the check for the active list didn’t run on the Tasks page or the page state didn’t refresh/wasn’t revisited after archiving, so the system couldn’t reliably prove the tasks were removed from the active view.
A follow-on error (“step file not found”) occurred after the failed verification, indicating the run could not continue once the confirmation step failed.
scenarios.kane_objective: On https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/ — Step 1 (SETUP): create a task titled 'Bulk archive A', mark it complete. Step 2 (SETUP): create a task titled 'Bulk archive B', mark it complete. Step 3 (VERIFY): click the 'Archive completed' button at the bottom of the task list. Step 4 (VERIFY): confirm both completed tasks are removed from the active list (they now appear on the Archive page). Stay on the AUT - do NOT navigate to any kaneai-playground or ecommerce-playground site. Stop immediately once confirmed. Do not navigate further.
